description: This source file implements a thread-local counter system for tracking various metrics, including definitions of counters, updating counters per thread, aggregating final counters, and emitting counter data. It manages a global counter block and maintains metadata for each counter, supporting concurrent updates and thread-specific event tracking.

methods.name: void tr2_counter_increment(enum trace2_counter_id cid,uint64_t value)
methods.description: Increments a specific thread-local counter by a given value.

methods.name: void tr2_update_final_counters(void)
methods.description: Aggregates thread-local counters into a final global counter block, assuming the caller holds the necessary mutex.

methods.name: void tr2_emit_per_thread_counters(tr2_tgt_evt_counter_t * fn_apply)
methods.description: Calls a provided function to emit per-thread counters that are marked as wanted per thread and used in the current thread.

methods.name: void tr2_emit_final_counters(tr2_tgt_evt_counter_t * fn_apply)
methods.description: Emits the final aggregated counters by calling a provided function for each counter that has a non-zero value, assuming the caller has the required lock.

ctags.name: final_counter_block
ctags.pattern: /^static struct tr2_counter_block final_counter_block; \/* access under tr2tls_mutex *\/$/
